description: Source code for the 'git prune' command, handling object pruning, reachability traversal, and temporary file cleanup.

methods.name: prune_tmp_file
methods.description: Removes a temporary file or directory if it is stale based on modification time and 'expire' threshold.

methods.name: perform_reachability_traversal
methods.description: Performs reachability traversal to mark reachable objects in the repository.

methods.name: is_object_reachable
methods.description: Checks if a specific object is reachable in the repository.

methods.name: prune_object
methods.description: Prunes a specific object if it is not reachable and meets expiration criteria.

methods.name: prune_cruft
methods.description: Removes temporary object files starting with 'tmp_obj_'.

methods.name: prune_subdir
methods.description: Removes subdirectories if not in dry-run mode.

methods.name: remove_temporary_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files in a given directory, especially those starting with 'tmp_'.

methods.name: cmd_prune
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git prune' command, parsing options, initializing revisions, and orchestrating pruning operations.
